PTC Industries Raises ₹1,800 Crore
Through Qualified Institutions Placement
Significant participation from global institutional investors reinforces confidence in PTC’s long-term
growth strategy and advanced manufacturing platform
This capital raise strengthens PTC Group’s ability to pursue organic expansion, strategic investments and
inorganic growth opportunities across aerospace, defence, space, energy and strategic materials
Lucknow, October 13, 2026: PTC Industries Limited (NSE: PTCIL | BSE: 539006) today announced the successful
completion of its Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP), raising ₹1,800 crore from institutional investors.
IS SUE SIZE

SHARES IS SUED

The QIP witnessed strong demand from both international and domestic institutional investors and was oversubscribed over
5 times the issue size, with a significant portion of the demand coming from global institutional investors.
The depth and quality of this participation marks an important milestone for PTC. It reflects growing recognition of the
Company’s long-term industrial strategy, its advanced manufacturing capabilities, and the significant opportunities before
the Group across aerospace, defence, space, energy and strategic sectors.
The successful QIP strengthens PTC’s capital base and provides the Company with additional financial flexibility to support
the next phase of growth across PTC Industries and its subsidiaries, including Aerolloy Technologies Limited in India and
Trac Precision Solutions Limited in the United Kingdom.

PTC Group's Advanced Manufacturing & Technology Centre, Lucknow

A Stronger Platform for Global Growth

Over the past several years, PTC Industries has made sustained investments in advanced materials, metallurgy, precision
castings, complex manufacturing technologies and global aerospace capabilities. These investments have positioned the
Group to participate more deeply in high-value manufacturing supply chains for aerospace, defence, space, energy and
other advanced industrial applications.

 Through Aerolloy Technologies Limited, the Group is developing an integrated platform for Titanium and Superalloy
materials, advanced castings and related manufacturing capabilities. Through Trac Precision Solutions, the Group has
added specialised precision engineering capability, an established international manufacturing presence and experience in
complex aerospace and industrial components.
Together, these businesses are strengthening the Group’s position across strategic materials, castings, machining and
precision manufacturing, enabling PTC to address increasingly complex requirements from customers in India and
international markets.
This ambition is reflected in PTC ONE™ - from Melt to Mission™, the Group’s vision of bringing together advanced
materials, metallurgy, precision castings, forging, machining, quality systems and customer delivery into one integrated
industrial platform.
Funding the Next Phase of Organic and Inorganic Growth

The proceeds of the QIP will be deployed in accordance with the objects set out in the placement document dated October
9, 2026 ("Placement Document") and applicable approvals.
The capital raised is intended to support the Company’s growth strategy, including organic expansion, capability and
capacity enhancement, investment in new projects, strategic initiatives and inorganic growth opportunities across the
Group. The Company believes this stronger capital base will be an important enabler in converting opportunities across
aerospace, defence, space, energy and advanced manufacturing into sustainable long-term businesses.
Chairman and Managing Director’s Statement

Commenting on the transaction, Mr. Sachin Agarwal, Chairman and Managing Director, PTC Industries Limited, said:
“This is a defining moment in PTC’s journey. The strong response to our QIP, and particularly the significant participation
from global institutional investors alongside respected domestic institutions, is a powerful affirmation of the confidence
placed in what we are building.
What makes this especially meaningful is that many of these global institutions understand the aerospace, defence,
space, energy and advanced manufacturing ecosystems at a global level. They understand the scale of the opportunity,
the strength of the demand environment, and also the real constraints in the supply chain - the availability of qualified,
reliable and scalable manufacturing capability in critical materials and components.
For many years, our conviction has been that India must develop the ability to manufacture the advanced materials and
critical components on which the world’s most demanding industries depend. We have worked steadily towards that
goal, investing in technologies, people, infrastructure and manufacturing capabilities that take years to build, qualify
and establish.
Today, with PTC Industries, Aerolloy Technologies and Trac Precision Solutions, we have a strong foundation across
materials, castings, machining and precision manufacturing. The capital raised through this QIP gives us the financial
strength to pursue the next phase of growth with greater ambition and flexibility, both organically and through carefully
considered strategic opportunities.
I am deeply grateful to our investors, our Board, our employees, and every institution and professional who contributed
to making this transaction possible. This is an important achievement for PTC, but more importantly, it is an opportunity
to build something far more significant in the years ahead.”

 Aarti Industries enters into a 10+ year strategic and dedicated manufacturing &
supply agreement with a global speciality chemical company
The dedicated long-term arrangement offers an estimated revenue potential of ₹1,500
crores over the contract period.
Mumbai, October 13, 2026: Aarti Industries Limited (AIL), a leading global manufacturer of
speciality chemicals, today announced that it has entered into a 10+ year dedicated
manufacturing and supply agreement with a leading global speciality chemical company serving
diverse industries with a cumulative revenue potential of approximately Rs 1500 crores (about
US$150 million) over its contract term. The agreement establishes a new customer relationship
for AIL and supports the customer’s expanding requirements in India.
AIL will set up, commission, and operate a dedicated manufacturing facility in India for a speciality
chemical used in high-performance applications, based on the customer's proprietary process
technology and a structured financial arrangement to finance CAPEX of less than US$25 million.
The model combines global technology with AIL’s process scale-up, engineering, and operating
capabilities to provide a critical manufacturing outsourcing solution to global companies.
Commercial operations are expected to commence in FY2028–29, subject to applicable
approvals.
By localising manufacturing through a dedicated Indian setup, this arrangement will support
supply-chain resilience and the customer’s growth plans in India.
For AIL, the agreement broadens its global customer base, strengthens its strategic
manufacturing portfolio and creates a platform to deepen the relationship as the customer’s India
requirements grow.
Commenting on the development, Mr Suyog Kotecha, Managing Director and Chief
Executive Officer, Aarti Industries Limited, said:
“This agreement brings a new global customer into AIL’s portfolio and reflects the
confidence placed in our ability to establish and operate dedicated manufacturing assets
to global standards. The model combines the customer’s proprietary technology with AIL’s
strengths in scale-up engineering, execution and reliable operations.
The long-term domestic supply arrangement provides sustained visibility while creating a
capital-efficient platform for growth. It also gives both organisations a foundation to

Mumbai, 13th October 2026: Shraddha Prime Projects Limited (BSE: 531771; NSE:
SHRADDHA), a Mumbai-focused real estate developer, today announced the launch of
Param Adarsh, a 21-storey development located in Mulund West, Mumbai. Situated
directly opposite Mulund West railway station, the project benefits from a prominent
location in an established residential neighbourhood with better connectivity.
With an estimated Gross Development Value (GDV) of approximately ₹120 crore, Param
Adarsh adds to the Company’s development portfolio and reflects its continued focus on
well-located residential opportunities across Mumbai. The project’s proximity to the
railway station provides convenient access to public transport and key areas of the city,
making it a strategically positioned development in the Mulund West micro-market.
Commenting on the launch, Mr. Sudhir Balu Mehta, Managing Director, Shraddha
Prime Projects Limited, said:
“Mulund has been an important market for us, and Param Adarsh gives us an opportunity
to strengthen our presence in the area. Its location, right opposite Mulund West railway
station, is a key advantage for residents looking for convenient connectivity within
Mumbai.
With an estimated GDV of approx. ₹120 crore, the project adds to our development pipeline
as we continue to expand our presence across established Mumbai neighbourhoods. Our
focus will remain on quality construction, efficient execution and delivering homes that
meet the needs of today’s homebuyers.”
About Shraddha Prime Projects Ltd:
Shraddha Prime Projects Limited (BSE: 531771; NSE: SHRADDHA) is a growing
Mumbai-based real estate developer with a diversified portfolio spanning residential
developments, slum rehabilitation (SRA) projects, redevelopment initiatives, and MHADA
projects. The company caters to a broad spectrum of homebuyers by offering a wide range
of housing solutions, including affordable homes, compact residences, premium, and
super-premium dwellings. With a strong focus on quality, inclusivity, and execution,
Shraddha Prime continues to strengthen its presence in the Mumbai real estate market.

businesses. Through its Navratri Special Offer, Capri Loans is helping customers access funds against

 Shyam Metalics Group Secures Strategic Mining Rights for Phutamura
Coal Block to Strengthen Backward Integration
Kolkata, India, October 13, 2026 - Shyam Metalics Group has announced a major strategic
advancement in its resource security and operational footprint through an investment in Alom
Solar Private Limited, who has been declared as the successful bidder for the Phutamura Coal
Block mining rights.
Located in the Raigarh District of Chhattisgarh within the prolific Mand Raigarh coalfield, the
Phutamura Coal Block spans an area of approximately 7.324 sq. km. and holds estimated coal
reserves of approximately 170 million tonnes. It is expected that mining Operations and Coal
Production shall commence from July 2027.
This strategic development serves as a crucial backward integration initiative for Shyam
Metalics Group, designed to secure a stable, long-term, and cost-effective coal supply to
support its captive power generation and core steel manufacturing processes. By securing vital
raw material reserves, the Group reinforces its commitment to operational self-sufficiency,
sustainable growth, and long-term value creation for its stakeholders.
Commenting on this significant development, Mr. Brij Bhushan Agarwal - Chairman &
Managing Director of Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited said:
"Our Groups investment in Alom Solar Private Limited and the securing of the Phutamura Coal
Block marks a pivotal milestone in our strategic journey toward absolute self-reliance. As we
continue to scale our manufacturing capabilities, securing high-quality, long-term raw material
linkages is paramount. With an estimated 170 million tonnes of coal reserves in the Mand–
Raigarh coalfield, this development significantly strengthens our backward integration
framework, ensuring uninterrupted fuel security for our captive power plants and core steel
operations. It underscores our unwavering commitment to sustainable growth, operational
resilience, and long-term value creation for all our stakeholders."
About Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited
Shyam Metalics is a leading and fastest-growing integrated metal-producing company based
in India primarily in the steel industry in West Bengal, Odisha, Jharkhand, and Madhya Pradesh
with a focus on Long & Flat Steel Products, Ferro Alloys, Aluminium, and Stainless Steel. The
company got listed itself on the exchanges in 2021 and possesses a market capitalization of
more than ₹ 30,000 Cr. Headquartered in Kolkata, West Bengal, the company is amongst the
largest producers of ferro alloys in terms of installed capacity in India.
The company has an aggregate installed metal capacity of 16.93 MTPA across the steel value
chain and is supported by a 467 MW aggregated installed capacity of captive power plants. For
more information, please visit our website at https://www.shyammetalics.com/.

Engineering S.r.l., the Company will undertake the interior design of the Vande Bharat sleeper
trainset, further strengthening its presence in India’s railway sector.

contract, valued at ₹3.93 crores

Letter of Acceptance

The contract represents a step forward in Airfloa’s participation in specialised railway projects,
extending its engagement into interior design and associated development for a major passenger rail
programme. The award reinforces three strategic priorities for the Company:

▪ Building on its established railway interiors, seating and furnishing activities, the assignment
expands the scope of work undertaken by Airfloa within the railway sector

▪ The contract strengthens Airfloa’s engagement with Integral Coach Factory, Chennai, and
provides an opportunity to demonstrate its capabilities in a technically specialised project

▪ The award aligns with Airfloa’s focus on strengthening its core railway business through
technical execution, quality and participation in specialised engineering assignments

Highlights

Frog Innovations and LigoWave formed a strategic manufacturing partnership at IMC 2026.
Frog Innovations will manufacture LigoWave's wireless broadband and Wi-Fi products in India.
Manufacturing is set to begin in 2026 at Frog Innovations' Noida facility.
The partnership targets India's wireless broadband and enterprise Wi-Fi market, projected to
exceed ₹8,300 crore by FY2032.

NEW DELHI: Frog Innovations, a homegrown telecom gear maker, and
US-based wireless networking company LigoWave on Monday said they
have signed a strategic manufacturing and business partnership at the
recently concluded India Mobile Congress (IMC 2026).
Under the alliance, Frog Innovations will manufacture LigoWave's
wireless broadband and Wi-Fi product portfolio in India. These products
will be marketed under the jointly branded FROG LigoWave name.
Manufacturing is expected to commence during calendar year 2026 at
Frog Innovations' facility in Noida.
The partnership aims to capitalise on India's growing demand for
wireless broadband and enterprise Wi-Fi solutions. India's Point-to-Point
(PtP) and Point-to-Multipoint (PtMP) radio equipment market is
projected to reach ₹4,840 crore by FY2032 from ₹2,200 crore in FY2025.
The enterprise Wi-Fi access systems market is expected to grow to
₹3,520 crore by FY2032 from ₹1,800 crore in FY2025, the companies said
citing third-party market estimates.
Advt

Together, these segments represent a combined market opportunity of
around ₹4,000 crore, projected to exceed ₹8,300 crore by FY2032. Frog
Innovations and LigoWave aim to strengthen their market presence with
competitively priced, locally manufactured solutions. They will also
explore opportunities to expand their footprint across international
markets.
This alliance marks Frog Innovations' entry into the wireless broadband
and enterprise networking market. It expands its portfolio beyond
wireless coverage solutions and Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS). The
product portfolio will include PtP and PtMP wireless broadband radios,
enterprise Wi-Fi access points, and advanced wireless networking
solutions. These solutions are used by telecom operators, Internet
Service Providers (ISPs), enterprises, and infrastructure providers.
Konark Trivedi, MD, Frog Innovations, said, "This partnership represents
an important milestone in Frog Innovations' growth journey and supports
our vision of building a globally competitive telecom technology
company from India. By combining LigoWave's proven wireless
technology with our manufacturing capabilities, we are creating a
compelling portfolio of broadband and networking products for
operators, ISPs and enterprise customers worldwide."
Edward Ho, CEO, LigoWave, said, "India is one of the world's fastestgrowing telecommunications markets, and we are delighted to partner
with Frog Innovations. Together, we will combine technology innovation
and manufacturing excellence to deliver reliable, high-performance
wireless broadband and Wi-Fi solutions for customers across India and
global markets."
Advt

Girish Nair, India Country Manager of Ligowave, added, “With this
partnership, we look forward to improving our market share in India and
achieving 3X growth. Our immediate plans are to locally manufacture
our latest technology of 11AX and 11BE products in India, which has huge
market demand. I am very confident that a partnership with Frog
Innovations will give us the platform to build high-quality products at
low cost”.

“Goodluck Defence approved as the Sole Eligible & Technically Qualified

Munitions India Limited”
12th October, 2026
Goodluck India Ltd is pleased to announce that its subsidiary, Goodluck Defence & Aerospace Ltd (GDAL),
has emerged as the sole technically qualified bidder for the supply of specialised 155 mm HE M1A4 Readyto-Fill Artillery Shells to Munitions India Limited (MIL), following the audit and technical evaluation of
various existing suppliers.
The qualification underscores GDAL’s manufacturing capabilities, quality standards, and technical
competence in meeting the specialised requirements of the defence sector. Following the evaluation process,
GDAL has been identified as the only technically qualified supplier for this specialised product.
This development represents an important milestone for Goodluck India Ltd and strengthens the company’s
strategic presence in the defence manufacturing ecosystem. It also reinforces the company’s commitment
to developing specialised manufacturing capabilities, adhering to stringent quality requirements, and
contributing to India’s growing defence manufacturing capabilities under the Government of India’s
Atmanirbhar Bharat initiative.
This technical qualification positions Goodluck Defence & Aerospace Ltd favourably for potential business
opportunities relating to 155 mm HE M1A4 Ready-to-Fill Artillery Shells, subject to applicable procurement
procedures, commercial terms, contractual requirements, and orders from Munitions India Limited.
Commenting on the development, Mr. Mahesh Chandra Garg, Chairman, Goodluck India Limited, stated
" We are delighted that our subsidiary, Goodluck Defence & Aerospace Ltd, has been recognised as the sole
technically qualified bidder for 155 mm HE M1A4 Ready-to-Fill Artillery Shells to Munitions India Limited
following the audit and evaluation of various manufacturing plants. This achievement is a testament to our
focus on technical excellence, manufacturing quality, and our commitment to meeting the demanding
requirements of the defence sector.
We view this qualification as an important strategic milestone in the development of our defence business.
It reflects the capabilities we are building within the Group and our determination to participate meaningfully
in India’s evolving defence manufacturing landscape.
We remain committed to strengthening our manufacturing capabilities, maintaining the highest standards of
quality and compliance, and creating sustainable long-term value for our stakeholders. We believe this
achievement provides a strong foundation for exploring further opportunities in the defence sector while
contributing to the nation’s vision of greater self-reliance in defence manufacturing."

 About Goodluck India Limited:
Founded in 1986, Goodluck India Limited is a premier engineering solutions provider specializing in the
manufacturing of Defence Products, High-End Forgings, Heavy Fabrication of Steel Structures for High Speed
Railway Network and Infrastructure Projects, Automotive Tubing and Others. The company is led by firstgeneration techpreneur Mr. Mahesh Chandra Garg, an IIT Roorkee alumnus, and supported by three
generations of professionally qualified family members, showcasing a legacy of over 40 years of industry
excellence.
Goodluck India has evolved from a traditional manufacturer to a diversified engineering solutions provider
with a strong presence in high-growth sectors such as Automotive, Solar, Railways, Defence, and
Infrastructure. The company’s diverse product portfolio ranges from ERW pipes to railway bridges, catering
to industries like construction, oil & gas, renewable energy, and more. Its strategic involvement in emerging
sectors, including Defence and active participation in India's first Bullet Train project, highlights its
commitment to innovation and technological advancement.
Operating six state-of-the-art manufacturing plants across Uttar Pradesh and Gujarat, with a total capacity
of 5,00,000 MTPA (including 2,85,000 MTPA of high-margin value-added products), Goodluck India serves
over 600 customers globally, exporting to more than 100 countries. In addition, the company’s subsidiary,
Goodluck Defence & Aerospace Ltd, operates a dedicated defence manufacturing plant with an annual
capacity of 1,50,000 shells and being further expanded to 400,000 shells per annum. The company employs
over 4,000 professionals dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency, backed by
ISO 9001:2008 certification.
Goodluck India continues to focus on driving growth through strategic investments in technology, product
diversification, and expanding its global footprint, with a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and
sustainability.
